panel.name: Inbox
panel.hint: Tickets with no session yet. A flat wagon is a ticket nobody started.
panel.empty: No open tickets without a session.

lever.label: START
lever.name: Start the urgent tickets
lever.prompt: {skill} Start work on {n|this ticket|these tickets}: {list}. Group them by area. Commit on each branch. Do not push and do not open a pull request. Report, then ask me.

panel.name: Building
panel.hint: A session is on it. Steam means it is working now.

lever.label: REVIEW
lever.name: Review what is ready
lever.prompt: {skill} Review {n|this branch|these branches} with fresh eyes, one at a time: {list}. Give a verdict for each. Do not change code.

panel.name: Your move
panel.empty: No PR needs a fix or a merge.

lever.label: FIX
lever.name: Fix the blockers
lever.prompt: {skill} Fix the review blockers on {n|this pull request|these pull requests}, one at a time, in this order: {list}. Commit on each pull request branch. Do not push. Report, then ask me which to push.

panel.name: Reviewers
panel.hint: Open PRs that need a human.
panel.empty: No PR is waiting for review.

lever.label: CHASE
lever.name: Chase the reviews
lever.prompt: {skill} Find the right reviewer for {n|this pull request|these pull requests}: {list}. Draft the requests. Do not send anything until I agree.

panel.name: Release road {release}
panel.hint: Merged, not in Production. Staging is {staging}.

lever.label: SHIP
lever.name: Cut the release
lever.prompt: {skill} {count} merged {n|change is|changes are} not in Production. Production is {production}. Staging is {staging}. Prepare the next release. Ask me before each deploy.

panel.name: Arrived in {liveIn}
panel.hint: Live. Post the evidence, then close the ticket.

lever.label: CLOSE
lever.name: Close out the release
lever.prompt: {skill} {n|This change is|These changes are} live in {liveIn}: {list}. Draft the evidence comments. Do not post a comment or move a ticket until I agree.
